description: Committed, version-controlled artifact provisioning the SECOND Cloud Scheduler job that triggers the intraday 4H validation Cloud_Run_Job at ~08:00 UK (intraday-validation feature). Separate from the 17:00-NY daily trigger; the daily Job is untouched.
notes: Schedule derives from Europe/London so the ~08:00 UK trigger tracks UK DST automatically; the Job itself derives the forming 4H bar from fixed UTC boundaries, so no fixed-offset assumption is made.

Reuses existing secrets by NAME only: TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY (intraday 4H feed), supabase-key, supabase-url (storage), DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUCKET (snapshot republish). Optional TWELVE_DATA_BASE_URL overrides the provider base URL.

Apply the additive migration supabase/migrations/20260916000010_intraday_validations.sql out-of-band (operator), consistent with project convention. The SupabaseIntradayValidationStore reads/writes fail-safe, so a torn deploy is harmless.

AFTER the one-time bootstrap below, the Cloud Run Job `intraday-validation-run` is (re)deployed on EVERY backend deploy by .github/workflows/deploy.yml (step 'Deploy SHA-pinned image to intraday validation Job', `gcloud run jobs deploy`, same SHA-pinned image + runtime SA, entrypoint dist/scheduled-run/intradayMain.js), so its image can never go stale. Only the Cloud Scheduler job below is still operator-managed.
Provisioning gotcha: the DASHBOARD_SNAPSHOT_BUCKET value must be NON-EMPTY; an empty value silently turns the snapshot republish into a logged no-op (the workflow step fails fast on an empty value).
The agent takes NO live-cloud action; these commands are operator-gated.

commands.affectedResource: Cloud Run Job "intraday-validation-run" (same image as scheduled-daily-run, overriding the container command to run the intraday entrypoint)

commands.command: gcloud scheduler jobs create http intraday-validation-run-0800-uk --schedule='0 8 * * 1-5' --time-zone=Europe/London --uri=https://europe-west1-run.googleapis.com/v2/projects/trade-assistant-508806/locations/europe-west1/jobs/intraday-validation-run:run --http-method=POST --oauth-service-account-email=scheduler-invoker@trade-assistant-508806.iam.gserviceaccount.com --max-retry-attempts=2 --project=trade-assistant-508806 --location=europe-west1
